name: Seeping Bilewretch

Traits.name: Seeping Caustic
Traits.text: At the start of each of its turns, the bilewretch takes 9 (2d8) Poison damage, and its space and every space within its reach become difficult terrain slick with poison until the start of its next turn.
Traits.clause: At the start of each of its turns, the bilewretch takes {dmg} Poison damage as its flesh consumes itself, and the causti
Traits.expressedQuote: its space and every space within its reach become difficult terrain slick with poison until the start of its next turn

Traits.name: Regeneration
Traits.text: The bilewretch regains 10 Hit Points at the start of each of its turns. If the bilewretch takes Fire damage, this trait doesn't function on the bilewretch's next turn. The bilewretch dies only if it starts its turn with 0 Hit Points and doesn't regenerate.

Actions.name: Multiattack
Actions.text: The bilewretch makes three Toxin-Slick Slam attacks.

Actions.name: Toxin-Slick Slam
Actions.text: *Melee Attack Roll:* +7, reach 10 ft. 8 (1d8 + 4) Bludgeoning damage plus 7 (2d6) Poison damage. If the target is a creature, its Hit Point maximum decreases by an amount equal to the damage taken.
weldedRiders: If the target is a creature, its Hit Point maximum decreases by an amount equal to the damage taken.

lore: Bred from a careless alchemist's vat of self-devouring distillate, it crawls the fens weeping caustic sap, seeking anything it can smear and dissolve.
